svg.title: Native two-band fluorescence collection — OpticalSetup setup
svg.desc: A 488 nm beam excites custom 530 and 610 nm fluorescence channels. A side-view collection lens, pump-rejection filter and dichroic feed separate green and red detectors; the transmitted pump has its own forward detector. Native sample fluorescence and wavelength-selective routing are traced. Forward detection here measures transmitted excitation, not unmodeled forward scatter. Flow events, cell statistics, elastic side scatter, photon yield and spectral compensation are not simulated.
